title: profile_column: return a stat/value profile of a single column
description: Inspect a single column and return its dtype, missing rate, unique value count, top values, and min/max. Does not modify the dataset. Use before filtering or grouping to understand column content.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: Name of the column to profile.

rag_note: Returns a stat/value DataFrame. Does not change the dataset. Use to diagnose column quality or understand value distribution before applying a filter or group_by.
